title: Global ringed-space derived counit comparison square
statement: For p:(X,O_X)→(pt,Γ(X,O_X)), write S=Γ(X,-). Take the ordinary global tensor pullback P and adj:P⊣S as in lem-sc-module-cup-global-tensor-pullback, and a comparison α:Qh L→H(P) Qh for its absolute left derived functor L. Let R=S.rightDerivedFunctor and β=S.rightDerivedFunctorUnit. The adjunction adj_D:L⊣R is the one induced from adj, α and β (not an arbitrary adjunction). For every homotopy complex K of O_X-modules, the square L(Qh(SK))→Qh(P(SK)), down L(β_K) to L(R(Qh K)), across adj_D.counit to Qh K commutes: L.map β_K followed by adj_D.counit_{Qh K} = α_{H(S)K} followed by Qh of the ordinary counit at K. The formal hypotheses on the two postcomposed derived functors express absoluteness, already supplied for p by the absolute K-flat derivation and the K-injective right derivation. No K-injectivity or boundedness is required of K.

proof.text: Apply Mathlib Adjunction.derivedε_fac_app to adj.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ), with the given left-derived comparison α and the canonical right-derived unit of global sections. Adjunction.derived uses this same derived counit, so its factorization is definitionally the displayed equation. This is the counit clause of lem-sc-derived-adjunction-from-underived. No pullback existence theorem or resolution construction is needed for this specialization under the stated derived-functor instances.

      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)))
    (α : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶

    (adj : P ⊣ RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace)
    [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor α (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Functor.IsLeftDerivedFunctor
      (L ⋙ (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor)
        ((Functor.associator _ _ _).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor)
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    [Functor.IsRightDerivedFunctor
      ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ L)
        (Functor.whiskerRight
            (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit L ≫
          (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom)
        (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (K : HomotopyCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
      (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) :
    L.map ((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit.app K) ≫
        (((adj.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).derived
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ))
          (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) α
          (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).rightDerivedFunctorUnit).counit.app
            (DerivedCategory.Qh.obj K)) =
      α.app (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace).mapHomotopyCategory
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
        DerivedCategory.Qh.map
          ((adj.mapHomotopyCategory (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).counit.app K)
